import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] A = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] B = new char[12][12];
    static int n, t;
    static boolean[][][][][] _dp = new boolean[70][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][] dp = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] tim = new int[12][12];

    static void setdp(int tt, int x, int y, int x0, int y0) {
        if (t >= 70) return;
        if (x < 0 || x >= n || y < 0 || y >= n) return;
        if (A[x][y] < '0' || A[x][y] > '9') return;
        if (tt > t + 1) return;
        if (_dp[tt][x][y][x0][y0]) return;
        if (tim[x][y] != 0 && tt > tim[x][y]) return;
        if (tim[x][y] != 0 && tt == tim[x][y] && (B[x][y] > '9' || B[x][y] <= '0')) return;
        _dp[tt][x][y][x0][y0] = true;

        if (tt < tim[x][y]) {
            setdp(tt + 1, x, y, x0, y0);
            setdp(tt + 1, x + 1, y, x0, y0);
            setdp(tt + 1, x - 1, y, x0, y0);
            setdp(tt + 1, x, y + 1, x0, y0);
            setdp(tt + 1, x, y - 1, x0, y0);
        }
    }

    static List<List<Integer>> G = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[][] F = new int[210][210];
    static int[] E = new int[210], H = new int[210];
    static int[][] C = new int[210][210];
    static int[][] pN = new int[11][11];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String lineA = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                A[i][j] = lineA.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String lineB = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                B[i][j] = lineB.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(tim[i], -1);
        }

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    tim[i][j] = 0;
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        int[] di = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dj = {0, -1, 0, 1};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            if (tim[x][y] >= t) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + di[d], ny = y + dj[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && A[nx][ny] >= '0' && A[nx][ny] <= '9' && tim[nx][ny] == -1) {
                    tim[nx][ny] = tim[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (tim[i][j] == -1) {
                    tim[i][j] = t;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] >= '0' && A[i][j] <= '9') {
                    setdp(0, i, j, i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                pN[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }

        G.add(new ArrayList<>());

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++) {
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
                    for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                        for (int nt = 0; nt <= t; nt++) {
                            if (nt >= 0 && nt < _dp.length && _dp[nt][i1][j1][i2][j2]) {
                                dp[i1][j1][i2][j2] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++) {
                if (A[i1][j1] > '0' && A[i1][j1] <= '9') {
                    int k = G.size();
                    G.add(new ArrayList<>());
                    E[k] = A[i1][j1] - '0';

                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                            if (B[i2][j2] > '0' && B[i2][j2] <= '9') {
                                if (dp[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                    int _k;
                                    if (pN[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                        _k = G.size();
                                        G.add(new ArrayList<>());
                                        pN[i2][j2] = _k;
                                    } else {
                                        _k = pN[i2][j2];
                                    }
                                    G.get(k).add(_k);
                                    G.get(_k).add(k);
                                    C[k][_k] = 10000;
                                    C[_k][k] = 0;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                if (B[i2][j2] > '0' && B[i2][j2] <= '9' && pN[i2][j2] > 0) {
                    int _k = pN[i2][j2];
                    G.get(_k).add(0);
                    C[_k][0] = B[i2][j2] - '0';
                    C[0][_k] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        while (true) {
            boolean ff = true;
            for (int i = 1; i < G.size(); i++) {
                while (E[i] > 0) {
                    boolean f = true;
                    int minH = 10000;
                    for (int _j = 0; _j < G.get(i).size(); _j++) {
                        int j = G.get(i).get(_j);
                        if (C[i][j] - F[i][j] > 0) minH = Math.min(minH, H[j]);
                        if (C[i][j] - F[i][j] > 0 && H[i] == H[j] + 1) {
                            int d = Math.min(C[i][j] - F[i][j], E[i]);
                            F[i][j] += d;
                            F[j][i] -= d;
                            E[i] -= d;
                            E[j] += d;
                            f = false;
                            ff = false;
                            if (E[i] == 0) break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (H[i] != minH + 1 && minH != 10000) {
                        H[i] = minH + 1;
                        f = false;
                        ff = false;
                    }
                    if (f) break;
                }
            }
            if (ff) break;
        }

        System.out.println(E[0]);
    }
}
